# akeyless_gateway_migration_hashi (Resource)

HashiCorp Vault Migration resource



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Migration name
- `target_location` (String) Target location in Akeyless for imported secrets

### Optional

- `hashi_json` (String) Import secret key as json value or independent secrets (relevant only for HasiCorp Vault migration) [true/false]
- `hashi_metadata_mode` (String) Controls the amount of HashiCorp Vault secret metadata migrated with each secret value. Options: none|minimal|full
- `hashi_ns` (List of String) HashiCorp Vault Namespaces is a comma-separated list of namespaces which need to be imported into Akeyless Vault. For every provided namespace, all its child namespaces are imported as well, e.g. nmsp/subnmsp1/subnmsp2,nmsp/anothernmsp. By default, import all namespaces (relevant only for HasiCorp Vault migration)
- `hashi_token` (String, Sensitive) HashiCorp Vault access token with sufficient permissions to preform list & read operations on secrets objects (relevant only for HasiCorp Vault migration)
- `hashi_url` (String) HashiCorp Vault API URL, e.g. https://vault-mgr01:8200 (relevant only for HasiCorp Vault migration)
- `protection_key` (String) The name of a key that used to encrypt the secret value (if empty, the account default protectionKey key will be used)
- `retry` (Block List, Max: 1) Retry this resource's operations when the error matches error_message_regex or the HTTP status is in retry_on_status_codes. Overrides the provider retry block. See the Customized Retry guide. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--retry))
- `target_name` (String) Name of existing target to use to create the migration

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `migration_id` (String) Migration ID

<a id="nestedblock--retry"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retry`

Optional:

- `error_message_regex` (List of String) Regular expressions matched against the error message. If any matches, the operation is retried.
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Wait before the first retry, in seconds. The wait doubles on each retry.
- `max_interval_seconds` (Number) Maximum wait between retries, in seconds.
- `max_retries` (Number) Maximum number of retries after the first attempt.
- `retry_on_status_codes` (List of Number) HTTP status codes of the failed API call that trigger a retry, for example 429 or 503.
